description: This file defines a Neo4j client class with methods for upserting entities, relationships, and embeddings into a Neo4j database. It manages connection setup based on configuration settings and includes logging for connection status and operations.

classes.name: Neo4jClient
classes.description: A minimal Neo4j client supporting upsert operations for entities, relationships, and embeddings. Conditional on environment settings, it operates either in active mode or no-op mode.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the Neo4jClient, setting up a database driver if connection parameters are present.

methods.name: _session(self)
methods.description: Context manager for managing Neo4j sessions; yields None if driver is not initialized.

methods.name: None upsert_entities(self, entities: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Performs an upsert (update or insert) of a list of entity records into the database.

methods.name: None upsert_relationships(self, relationships: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Performs an upsert of relationships between entities in the database.

methods.name: None upsert_embeddings(self, embeddings: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Updates or inserts embeddings for entities in the database.
